notes: Black Friday batch 4 from 5 user-supplied format references (2026-10-27): caution-tape luxury, never-again comparison, yes-it's-pricey note, quote + pills, heavier-woman insets. Lead offer EITHER 60% OFF SITEWIDE (Q48_01, 02, 05) OR buy 2 pairs + free socks and travel bag (Q48_03, 04). No prices, promo codes, 'ends tonight', stock-scarcity lines, star ratings, 'loved by thousands' or medical claims ('pain relief', 'fall prevention', 'swelling relief') from the refs. 'Never' softened to 'may never'. Q48_04's quote is built from Trustpilot 5-star language ('my feet aren't tired after a busy day'); swap in a verbatim review if preferred.

concepts.prompt: Dark luxury scene: black marble floor and backdrop with soft gold rim light, a little gold dust and light haze. Yellow caution tape printed with black "BLACK FRIDAY" crosses the top-left and bottom-right corners diagonally. Top center: big shiny gold heavy all-caps "BLACK FRIDAY SALE"; below it white all-caps "60% OFF SITEWIDE" with "60% OFF" in gold. Center: a pair of the black-and-white shoes from the product reference on a black marble podium, large and sharp at true proportions, with a loose gold satin ribbon beside them and a small gold hang tag on one shoe reading "60% OFF". Bottom center: a black rounded pill with a thin gold outline and gold all-caps "FREE SHIPPING & RETURNS". No promo code, no footnote. All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin.

concepts.angle: 'Yes, it's pricey' honest note: what cheap shoes wouldn't have, then the buy-2 free gifts
concepts.based_on: User reference: WorkFit 'YES, IT'S PRICEY' insoles text ad
concepts.headline: YES, IT'S PRICEY
concepts.prompt: Plain white background. Top: a huge heavy black all-caps title with a thick orange outline and slight drop shadow: "YES, IT'S PRICEY". Below, left-aligned black text: bold "We could make it cheaper. But then it'd be... well, cheap." Then a bullet list, each bullet with the named part in bold: "It wouldn't have " + bold "real arch support that holds up all day." / "It wouldn't have " + bold "a wide toe box that gives bunions room." / "It wouldn't have " + bold "stretch knit that gives when feet swell." Then bold "It wouldn't be ComfortWear." Then "Right now it comes with 2 gifts:". Bottom-left: heavy retro red all-caps text with a blue offset shadow, two lines: "BUY 2 PAIRS," / "GET 2 FREE GIFTS". Bottom-right: a pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference with a rolled 3-pack of plain socks and a light grey zip travel bag with the ComfortWear logo from the attached logo image printed on its front, all at true proportions, about 40% of the image width. All body text BIG for readers aged 60+: each line about 1/26 of the image height.
